deliverables.current: The repaired immutable five-target matrix passed all 12 report items. Parallel functional lanes took 52.177 seconds; the full batch including serialized user/machine MSI lifecycles took 641.437 seconds. Original Git bytes, paths and generated-account fixture cleanup passed.

deliverables.name: One final paired latency/performance batch
deliverables.current: Consolidated paired correctness/timing checks passed. The material Windows status regression was fixed; startup and 1k/10k/100k status improved against the default reference. Per latest user direction, git-next targets practical high performance rather than extreme latency tuning; the ultra-low-latency requirement belongs to GitSSS server.
deliverables.remaining: Measured boundary: 100k-file show metadata was 70.424ms versus 57.774ms (p95 78.754ms versus 63.701ms). Network remained comparable. No universal speedup or total process-tree memory claim; no further extreme tuning requested.
